categories.name: Parliamentary Procedure
categories.definition: Covers the rules, conduct, and daily business of the House of Commons, including debates, motions, rulings, and questions of privilege.

categories.name: Economy & Public Finance
categories.definition: Concerns the management of the national economy, including fiscal policy (budgets, spending, debt) and monetary policy (inflation, interest rates).

categories.name: Taxation
categories.definition: Focuses on government revenue policies, including personal and corporate income tax, sales taxes like the GST, and tariffs for revenue purposes.

categories.name: Trade & Foreign Affairs
categories.definition: Pertains to Canada's international relations, including trade agreements, diplomacy, international aid, and responses to global events, excluding military matters.

categories.name: Social Policy
categories.definition: Includes programs related to income security, health, education, and welfare, such as pensions, unemployment insurance, family allowances, and federal funding transfers for health and post-secondary education.

categories.name: Justice, Rights & Immigration
categories.definition: Covers the legal and justice system, including the Criminal Code, policing, courts, human rights, civil liberties, and immigration and refugee policy.

categories.name: Government & Electoral Affairs
categories.definition: Relates to the structure and administration of government, the public service, Crown corporations, official languages, and the electoral system.

categories.name: Constitutional & Intergovernmental Relations
categories.definition: Focuses on the Canadian constitution, the division of powers, national unity, and relations between the federal, provincial, and territorial governments.

categories.name: Sectoral Policy: Resources, Agriculture & Transport
categories.definition: Encompasses policies for specific economic sectors, including natural resources (energy, fisheries, forestry), agriculture, and transportation (rail, air, shipping).

categories.name: Defence & National Security
categories.definition: Pertains to the Canadian Armed Forces, national defence policy, military procurement, veterans' affairs, and national security operations.

natural_categories.name: Parliamentary Procedure
natural_categories.definition: Covers the rules, conduct, and daily business of the House of Commons, including debates, motions, rulings, and questions of privilege.

natural_categories.name: Macroeconomic Policy
natural_categories.definition: Concerns the overall management of the national economy, including inflation, interest rates, economic growth, and monetary policy.

natural_categories.name: Public Finance & Taxation
natural_categories.definition: Pertains to government revenues and expenditures, including the federal budget, taxation (e.g., GST, income tax), government spending, and the national debt.

natural_categories.name: International Trade
natural_categories.definition: Focuses specifically on policies governing cross-border commerce, such as free trade agreements, tariffs, export promotion, and trade disputes.

natural_categories.name: Foreign Affairs & Defence
natural_categories.definition: Relates to Canada's diplomatic and military posture, including foreign policy, international aid, peacekeeping, the armed forces, and national security.

natural_categories.name: Social Programs & Income Security
natural_categories.definition: Includes national social safety net programs, such as old age security, the Canada Pension Plan, unemployment insurance, and family allowances.

natural_categories.name: Health & Education
natural_categories.definition: Covers federal policies and funding related to the health care system and post-secondary education, including federal-provincial transfers for these areas.

natural_categories.name: Constitutional & Intergovernmental Relations
natural_categories.definition: Focuses on the Canadian constitution, national unity, federalism, and relations between federal, provincial, territorial, and Indigenous governments.

natural_categories.name: Agriculture & Natural Resources
natural_categories.definition: Encompasses policies for primary industries such as farming, fisheries, forestry, energy, and mining, as well as environmental protection.

natural_categories.name: Transportation, Infrastructure & Communications
natural_categories.definition: Covers policies for national transportation networks (rail, air, marine), public infrastructure projects, and communications (broadcasting, telecommunications).

natural_categories.name: Justice, Immigration & Human Rights
natural_categories.definition: Includes the legal system, law enforcement, and civil liberties, covering criminal law, policing, courts, immigration, and human rights legislation.

natural_categories.name: Government Operations
natural_categories.definition: Pertains to the administration of the federal government, including the public service, Crown corporations, electoral reform, official languages, and ethics.

natural_rationale: A 12-category scheme is empirically superior as it disaggregates several large and distinct policy domains that are conflated in a 10-category model, such as separating international trade from general foreign affairs, and macroeconomic management from public finance and taxation, which better reflects the distinct clusters of debate observed in the data.
